description: NaBe₂BO₃F₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.30 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four F atoms to form distorted NaF₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four BeO₃F tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.32 Å) Na-F bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Be sites. In the first Be site, Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form BeO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three BeO₃F tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaF₄ trigonal pyramid. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) Be-O bond length. The Be-F bond length is 1.54 Å. In the second Be site, Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form corner-sharing BeO₃F tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and one longer (1.67 Å) Be-O bond length. The Be-F bond length is 1.54 Å. In the third Be site, Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form BeO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three BeO₃F tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaF₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.67 Å. The Be-F bond length is 1.54 Å. In the fourth Be site, Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form corner-sharing BeO₃F tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) Be-O bond length. The Be-F bond length is 1.54 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond length. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.37 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Be and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Be and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Be and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Be and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Be and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Be and one B atom. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Be atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Be atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Be atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Be atom.
